_doc: Grounds for research/first_print_capture.py: which primary publishers it may fetch, what their robots.txt and terms said when this was written, and which series it captures. A publisher with verdict other than CONFIRMED or built != true is never fetched; its row is the record of why. robots.txt is re-read by the leg on every pass with its own agent and an unreadable file is a refusal, never a yes. No FRED, no ALFRED.
checked_how: from the build container: its egress proxy refuses api.bls.gov, oui.doleta.gov, api.census.gov and apps.bea.gov to direct HTTP, so robots.txt was read through a page reader where it would load and is otherwise UNMEASURED here; the leg reads it live on the box before any data request

bls.terms: US federal government work, public domain; BLS API terms of service permit automated access within the published limits (v2 registered: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, 20 years; v1 keyless: 25 queries/day, 25 series/query, 10 years)
bls.robots: www.bls.gov/robots.txt read 2026-11-18: User-agent * disallows /scripts /crs /_private /iisadmin /srchadm /advisory/members/ /idcf /*print*; no API path disallowed. api.bls.gov/robots.txt UNMEASURED from the container (the page reader declined it); the leg reads it live
bls.auth: BLS_API_KEY through libs.ops.env_keys.read_key and the credential registry's accepted names; absent -> keyless API v1, at most one request per 110 minutes (12/day, under v1's 25)

census.terms: Census Data API terms of service: free, keyless use allowed up to 500 queries per day per IP; products must carry the notice 'This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.'
census.notice: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
census.robots: api.census.gov/robots.txt UNMEASURED from the container (the page reader got a request-rejected page); the leg reads it live and fails closed
census.confirm_on_box: the EITS dataset path and the category/data-type codes are the publisher's as best known from a container that cannot reach the host; a wrong code returns the API's own error, recorded, never a zero

dol.terms: US federal government work, public domain
dol.robots: www.dol.gov/robots.txt read 2026-11-18: User-agent * disallows only CMS paths (/core/ /profiles/ /admin/ /search/ /user/*); oui.doleta.gov/robots.txt came back empty through the page reader (UNMEASURED)
dol.why_not: no keyless machine-readable endpoint carries the weekly headline: the DOL data API (dataportal.dol.gov) needs a registered key, the Thursday news release is a PDF, and oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/csv/ar539.csv is state-reported NSA claims that lag the headline by a week, so a value first seen there is not the release's first print

bea.terms: US federal government work, public domain
bea.robots: apps.bea.gov/robots.txt read 2026-11-18: User-agent * Disallow / with exceptions /scb/ /eFile/ /regional/bearfacts/ /histdatacore/ /api/ /international/factsheet/ /industry/factsheet/ /regional/rims/rimsii/
bea.why_not: the only robots-permitted machine route is /api/, and the BEA API requires a registered UserID: not keyless. The release tables are under paths robots disallows
